point: No verb follows the noun phrase: use the preposition in spite of.
名詞片語後面沒有動詞：用介系詞 in spite of。
why: After the blank is a noun phrase: the renovation work that its trustees had scheduled. Had scheduled belongs to the relative clause, so the noun has no verb of its own. A conjunction needs a clause, so the preposition in spite of fits the contrast.
空格後是名詞片語 the renovation work that its trustees had scheduled。had scheduled 屬於關係子句，所以這個名詞沒有自己的動詞。連接詞需要子句，因此用介系詞 in spite of 表示讓步。

gloss.ex: The renovation work will finish in March.
The trustees approved the new budget.
The gallery opens at nine on weekdays.

point: A full clause follows a comma: use the conjunction although.
逗號後接完整子句：用連接詞 although。
why: After the blank comes a full clause: subject the seating capacity that the fire marshal had approved in April and verb was. Only a comma comes before it, so a conjunction is needed. Although also fits the contrast.
空格後是完整子句：主詞 the seating capacity that the fire marshal had approved in April，動詞 was。前面只有逗號，所以需要連接詞。although 也符合對比的意思。

gloss.ex: The fire marshal inspected the hall before opening night.
The seating capacity of the hall is five hundred.

point: A gerund subject with its own verb follows: use because.
後面是以動名詞當主詞的子句：用 because。
why: Hiring two temporary receptionists for the front desk is the subject of cleared. A subject plus a verb makes a clause, so a conjunction is needed: because. A preposition here would leave cleared without a subject.
hiring two temporary receptionists for the front desk 是 cleared 的主詞。主詞加動詞就是子句，所以要連接詞 because。若用介系詞，cleared 就沒有主詞了。

gloss.ex: We cleared the backlog of orders last week.
The receptionist greets every visitor at the door.
Several unanswered emails were still in the inbox.

point: A noun phrase follows: use the preposition owing to.
後面接名詞片語：用介系詞 owing to。
why: A fault in the cooling system that technicians first detected is a noun phrase with no verb of its own, and the main clause starts only after the comma. A noun phrase needs a preposition, so the answer is Owing to.
a fault in the cooling system that technicians first detected 是名詞片語，沒有自己的動詞，主要子句要到逗號之後才開始。名詞片語前要用介系詞，所以答案是 Owing to。

gloss.ex: The cooling system failed during the heat wave.
The annual shutdown lasts two weeks.
Output rose by ten percent in June.

point: while + -ing links two actions of one subject.
while + Ving 連接同一主詞的兩個動作。
why: Boarding has its own object: passengers who need wheelchair assistance. So it is a verb form, and its doer is the two agents. While + -ing means "at the same time as" and fits.
boarding 有自己的受詞 passengers who need wheelchair assistance，所以它是動詞形式，動作者是 the two agents。while + Ving 表示「在……的同時」，符合句意。

gloss.ex: The speaker stepped up to the podium.
Guests can request wheelchair assistance at the desk.

point: No verb follows the noun: use the preposition during.
名詞後面沒有動詞：用介系詞 during。
why: The quarterly audit is a noun phrase. The words when every production system is frozen only add detail about the audit; they do not give it a verb. A time word before a noun phrase must be a preposition: during.
the quarterly audit 是名詞片語。when every production system is frozen 只是補充說明 audit，並沒有替它提供動詞。時間詞後面接名詞片語，必須用介系詞 during。

gloss.ex: The team will deploy the update tonight.
The annual audit begins in March.
The production system must stay online.

point: Before a clause use the conjunction before; prior to takes a noun.
接子句用連接詞 before；prior to 接名詞。
why: After the inserted who clause, the subject the warehouse supervisor gets its verb: had a chance to compare. A full clause follows the blank, so it needs a conjunction: before.
插入的 who 子句之後，主詞 the warehouse supervisor 的動詞出現了：had a chance to compare。空格後是完整子句，所以需要連接詞 before。

gloss.ex: A customs broker prepares the import forms.
The manifest lists every container on board.
Ms. Cho is on leave until Friday.

point: A noun follows: use the preposition after.
後面接名詞：用介系詞 after。
why: The wedding reception that the hotel hosts every Saturday evening is a noun phrase, so the time word before it must be a preposition. After takes a noun; it fits the order of events.
the wedding reception that the hotel hosts every Saturday evening 是名詞片語，前面的時間詞必須是介系詞。after 可以接名詞，也符合事情先後。

gloss.ex: The banquet room seats two hundred guests.
The reception starts at seven in the ballroom.
Please reset the room before noon.

point: unless + clause = if not; without + noun.
unless + 子句 = if not；without + 名詞。
why: The sender, or the accountant …, has submitted has a subject and a verb, so a clause follows. The meaning is: if no recall request is submitted, the bank cannot reverse the transfer. That is unless.
the sender, or the accountant …, has submitted 有主詞也有動詞，所以後面是子句。意思是：若沒有提交撤回申請，銀行就不能撤銷匯款。這是 unless。

gloss.ex: The wire transfer arrived within two hours.
She signed the form on behalf of her manager.
The bank received a recall request on Monday.

point: unless can be followed by a past participle.
unless 後面可以接過去分詞（省略 it is）。
why: Authorized in writing by the facilities office is a shortened clause: unless (it is) authorized. The meaning is "except when it is authorized in writing", which is unless.
authorized in writing by the facilities office 是縮短的子句：unless (it is) authorized。意思是「除非獲得書面授權」，所以用 unless。

gloss.ex: Only managers may authorize overtime pay.
Call the facilities office to book the hall.
The guard keeps a log of all visitors.

point: Two clauses joined by only a comma need a conjunction: whereas.
只用逗號連接兩個子句，要用連接詞：whereas。
why: A comma separates two full clauses: applications … rose by 14 percent and applications … fell. A comma alone cannot join them, so a conjunction is needed. Whereas also shows the contrast between urban and rural branches.
逗號隔開兩個完整子句：applications … rose by 14 percent 和 applications … fell。只靠逗號不能連接它們，所以需要連接詞。whereas 也表示都會與鄉村分行的對比。

gloss.ex: Her mortgage application was approved last week.
Urban branches handle most of the new accounts.
The bank opened a rural branch last spring.

point: Opposite ideas in two sentences: nevertheless.
兩句意思相反：用 nevertheless。
why: The first sentence gives a cost against moving: would cost a fifth more. The second says the board voted to move anyway, so the two ideas run in opposite directions. Nevertheless marks that turn.
第一句提出搬遷的缺點：would cost a fifth more。第二句卻說董事會 voted to move，兩個想法方向相反。Nevertheless 標示這個轉折。

gloss.ex: The printing plant runs three shifts a day.
The report cited rising costs as the main cause.
Prices will rise from March onward.

point: otherwise = if not: the result of not doing it.
otherwise = 如果不這樣做：沒做的後果。
why: The first part asks for something: return the signed loan agreement … by Friday. The second part says what happens if that is not done: the painting will be sent back. That relation is otherwise.
前半句提出要求：return the signed loan agreement … by Friday。後半句說沒做到會怎樣：the painting will be sent back。這種關係用 otherwise。

gloss.ex: The loan agreement covers six paintings.
The registrar keeps records of every object.

point: so that + clause gives a purpose with its own subject.
so that + 子句：有自己主詞的目的。
why: The online portal … would not be overloaded has its own subject and verb, so a clause follows the blank. A purpose clause with a new subject takes so that.
the online portal … would not be overloaded 有自己的主詞和動詞，所以空格後是子句。帶有新主詞的目的子句用 so that。

gloss.ex: Enrollment for the course closes on Friday.
The network was overloaded during the sale.
Staff log in to the portal each morning.

point: such + adjective + noun + that shows a result.
such + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that 表示結果。
why: Detailed feedback is an adjective plus a noun, followed by the result clause that it rewrote the entire onboarding guide. Before an adjective plus a noun, the word is such.
detailed feedback 是形容詞加名詞，後面接結果子句 that it rewrote the entire onboarding guide。形容詞加名詞的前面用 such。

gloss.ex: The pilot group tested the app for a month.
The onboarding guide explains the first week.
The rollout of the new system starts in May.

point: even if introduces something that may not happen.
even if 引導可能不會發生的事。
why: Who has not yet decided whether she will make the trip shows that cancelling is only a possibility. A possible event that has not yet happened takes even if.
who has not yet decided whether she will make the trip 顯示取消只是一種可能。尚未發生的可能情況用 even if。

gloss.ex: This non-refundable deposit secures your booking.
She received a credit for the cancelled flight.
She cancels the booking every year.

point: in case + clause: prepare now for something that may happen.
in case + 子句：先為可能發生的事做準備。
why: The room is already booked, before the numbers are known: only about a hundred and fifty have registered so far. Preparing ahead for a possible event is expressed by in case.
房間已經訂好（already booked），而報名人數還沒確定：目前只有約一百五十人。為可能發生的事提前準備，用 in case。

gloss.ex: The organizers booked a larger hall.
Each delegate receives a conference badge.
No complaints have been received to date.

point: as long as = on the condition that.
as long as = 在……的條件下。
why: The rate stays for twelve months only while the balance never falls below the minimum. That is a condition that must stay true, which as long as expresses.
只有在 the balance never falls below the minimum 的情況下，利率才維持十二個月。這是必須持續成立的條件，用 as long as 表達。

gloss.ex: The promotional rate ends in December.
Check your balance before making a transfer.
The minimum order is fifty units.
